sources.title: Official GTA 6 trading cards are coming next month
sources.text: GTA 6’s in-game trading cards are getting a physical release this December Grand Theft Auto 6 is getting an official trading card release. The GTA 6: Sports Trading Card Collection is being produced through a partnership between Rockstar and collectables distributor Panini America. The release is set for this December, so it’s just a few weeks away. The trading card collection will include a selection of cards that can be found in-game, centred around fictional sports stars and teams. The artwork on the cards ranges from stylised drawings and in-game character renders, just as you can find in GTA 6 itself. As with any other trading card release, there will be cards of varying rarities in each pack. Grand Theft Auto VI official trading cards, coming soon from @PaniniAmerica and @RockstarGames . pic.twitter.com/H1VrYVXTm5 Right now, there’s no word on when exactly they will be released, how much they will cost, and what regions they will be available in. All we know right now is that they will be distributed by Panini America, so it remains to be seen if fans outside of the US will be able to pick them up too. There isn’t currently a way to place a pre-order for these cards either. This partnership is among the first post-launch merch drops for GTA 6. Prior to the game’s launch, we saw Rockstar collaborate with the Miami Heat in the US for a sports-themed merch line. In the UK, there was a high-profile drop at Selfridges, with more than 60 items on sale . We can expect to see more partnerships like this in the future, as GTA 6 has just enjoyed record-breaking launch success. PlayStation says it’s the biggest launch of the console maker’s history , with 39 million players at launch. It earned $3.79 billion on release day too , eclipsing even GTA 5 , which previously broke records with its ultra-successful launch.

sources.title: Lords of the Fallen 2 delayed to April 2027, exact release date coming next month
sources.text: Lords of the Fallen 2 will now launch in April 2027, and we'll find out exactly when next month. The news came via a short post on X from CI Games founder and CEO Marek Tyminski. " Lords of the Fallen II: April 2027," he wrote . "Exact date in December." That means the Soulslike sequel has slipped again. Back in June , CI Games pushed Lords of the Fallen 2 into a Q1 2027 release window, saying the extra time would let the team refine the game and keep it clear of "a highly competitive holiday period". That was a delay in itself, as when CI Games and Epic ended the game's PC exclusivity deal in May, it was still targeting a 2026 release. Last month, CI Games secured a €28.6 million (around $32 million) loan to complete production and release Lords of the Fallen 2, as well as refinance its existing bank debt, according to a stock exchange filing . The loan matures on 31st August 2027, and, as reported at the time , CI Games will self-publish the game and expects to repay the loan through its sales. Lords of the Fallen II: April 2027. Exact date in December. pic.twitter.com/yYaevDqaxe Lords of the Fallen 2 is coming to PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2 , and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store. Following its announcement in 2025 and a look at gameplay during that year's The Game Awards , Lords of the Fallen 2 - which is technically the series' third game if we don't ignore the fact it was rebooted - had been steadily marching towards an unspecified 2026 launch. On PC, the plan was for it to be an Epic Games Store exclusive, but that's no longer happening after we learned CI Games - developer and sole owner of the IP - is now free from the multi-year exclusivity deal with Epic Games. The sequel has also been at the centre of heated conversations following CI Games founder and CEO Marek Tyminski's comments regarding "political correctness" and "real player feedback". The studio also raised eyebrows recently by announcing more revealing armour sets for female characters in Lords of the Fallen 2, for instance, compared to its previous project. Eurogamer gave the rebooted Lords of the Fallen two stars , calling it "a perfectly acceptable Soulslike that's often fun to play and offers the same satisfaction at overcoming adversity", but one let down by "Soulslike clichés and performance woes".

sources.title: You can expect a similar leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 as there is between GTA 5 and GTA 6, CD Projekt Red says
sources.text: CD Projekt Red has said people can expect a similar qualitative and technological leap from The Witcher 3 to The Witcher 4 as has been witnessed between Grand Theft Auto 5 and Grand Theft Auto 6 . CDPR joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski made the remark during a Q3 earnings call this afternoon, during which he and CDPR faced a handful of questions related to GTA 6. "First of all, obviously this is a call about us, not about Rockstar," Nowakowski began by saying, "but I do understand the connection here. Having said that, I'm not going to make a deep-dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course we did look at the game, we did see the differences. "We believe there's going to be a comparable leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 - I think so, yes. It's been 11 years, we are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game, so yes you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4." Another question was about whether GTA 6 had affected development plans for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2 - a question well-timed after Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski joked at the weekend that "Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled" because of how impressive GTA 6 is. "Is seeing GTA 6 launch making us make the games more expensive?" said Nowakowski. "We have certain ambitions when it comes to Witcher [4] and Cyberpunk 2; they have not changed when it comes to GTA 6. If anything happened as a result of GTA 6, it's [that it's] always great to see games like that because they show you how much cool stuff can be done, and that's for sure an inspiration in many ways for our developers." Specifically in terms of budget, Nowakowski said nothing had changed, and also echoed a point made earlier this year when he said Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2 are "not budget-driven developments". "I'm not saying we don't care about the budgets: we do, and I'm pretty sure [Rockstar] did as well. But you cannot make games like that having in mind 'this is the fixed number of money I want to spend and that's it, otherwise I'm gone'," he said. "They're ambition-driven developments and money's important - the budgets are not indefinite, that's not what we're saying. But the philosophy is like I said, and honestly that philosophy has not changed for us because of GTA 6's release; it has just always been like that." When asked whether the arrival of GTA 6 had impacted sales of The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 , Nowakowski answered "yes and no". "You do see a certain dip in engagement on the PlayStation and Xbox for sure," he said. Statistics apparently show a drop of "at least" 25 percent in CDPR's players as they "engaged themselves with GTA 6". "But you do have to remember that a lot of our players are PC-based," Nowakowski pointed out. "GTA has not launched on PC; we have not seen any impact whatsoever on the PC sales or engagement. So it's a bit of a mixed answer. "And also on the PS5 and Xbox, it's not like our sales came to zero," he added. "Some short impact, yes, on the consoles. Long-term, we do not really see that affecting ourselves in any material way in Q4." Finally, the questioning turned to marketing, which Rockstar has shown can reach far and wide if you have the brand-power of GTA and some imagination. We've seen prestigious department stores like Selfridges taken over by Rockstar for GTA 6 , trailers premiering on Netflix , Miami launch festivals - Rockstar's marketing department has gone all out. CDPR is no stranger to grabbing headlines with glitzy actor hirings such as Keanu Reeves , but will Rockstar's approach to marketing GTA 6 push it a step further? "The most important takeaway - I'm not sure if I'd call it a lesson because this is our playbook as well - is that if you want to reach a certain critical mass, you do have to get out of just the core gaming bubble, something we did in the past as well," Nowakowski said. "For sure, GTA 6 went there. "If the underlying question was if we're going to repeat or copy-paste their playbook: no, for sure not. Our games are different and they require a certain different approach - we just do things differently than they do. But in terms of the ultimate effect, in terms of breaking out to the mass market awareness: this is for sure something we consider pivotal to whatever we're going to do with our marketing campaigns in the future." CDPR's Q3 financial results were positive . The company made less money than this time last year, but the "fresh momentum" - as Nowakowski put it - provided to The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 by the release of the Remastered edition of Witcher 3 and the Edgerunners anime series on Netflix, and associated game update, went a long way. The Witcher 3 reached its highest concurrent player count on Steam as a result, and Cyberpunk 2077 reached its second highest concurrent player count, which represents serious staying power for both games so long after they were first released. And with Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past on track for 2027, and The Witcher 4 for 2028, the future is loaded.

sources.text: During the company’s Q3 2026 earnings report, CD Projekt Red announced a new partnership with Sony for The Witcher 4. sources.title: The leap from The Witcher 3 to The Witcher 4 will be "comparable" to GTA 5 and GTA 6, says CDPR
sources.text: It's GTA 6 's world, and we're just living in it. Rockstar's latest release is an astonishing technical achievement to behold, confounding even developers working on big-budget games like Naughty Dog's Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet . It's been 13 long years since GTA 5, but seeing the staggering advancements in visual detail, depth of interactivity, and overall scale in GTA 6, you'd think it's been even longer. And yet, CD Projekt Red says we'll see a similar technical leap in The Witcher 4 compared to The Witcher 3, which came out in 2015. During the Q&A portion of CDPR's latest earnings call, joint-studio CEO Michał Nowakowski fields a question about GTA 6 and whether The Witcher fans can expect a similar improvement from The Witcher 4. He says the team at CDPR "did look at [GTA 6]" and "did see the differences," and "we believe there's gonna be a comparable leap between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4." "It's been 11 years, we are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game, so yes, you can expect us to make a much bigger jump between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4," says Nowakowski. There aren't many (read: any) studios with GTA 6's budget, which of course is supplied by Rockstar parent company Take-Two Interactive, but CDPR definitely has the resources to craft huge, visually stunning worlds packed with detail and complex systems that rival today's most expansive AAA games. Cyberpunk 2077 is the most recent example, but even 11 years on, The Witcher 3 absolutely holds up to modern open-world standards. We're still a couple of years out from The Witcher 4's estimated 2028 release, but there's every reason to believe it'll make The Witcher 3 look downright dated, even after its recent remaster. Whether it'll truly mark a leap comparable to what Rockstar managed from GTA 5 to GTA 6 is a very different question we'll have to wait to answer. sources.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
sources.text: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey. Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir. Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course. There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back. Meanwhile, God of War Laufey was recently delayed from February 2027 to May 2027, giving the PS5 exclusive slightly more breathing room away from Fable, Persona 4 Revival and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential," developer Sony Santa Monica said at the time. "On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon." While the game puts Faye in the leading role as she battles with gods in a multi-mythological afterlife, the studio was quick to note that her journey isn't considered a side game. God of War Laufey will still connect to future games in the series and, yep, Kratos will eventually be back , too. "Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said of the online trolls who were targeting Laufey after its reveal this summer. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad."

sources.title: Agradecemos por tornarem Grand Theft Auto VI o maior lançamento da história PlayStation
sources.text: Uma homenagem à comunidade PlayStation e à Rockstar Games por proporcionarem um momento incrível para o universo dos games e do entretenimento. Após uma longa espera, os jogadores finalmente tiveram a chance de mergulhar em Grand Theft Auto VI . Foi incrível ver a comunidade PlayStation ao redor do mundo começar suas aventuras no estado de Leonida. Quer você tenha contado os dias para retornar às ruas de Vice City, ou esteja vivenciando a série Grand Theft Auto pela primeira vez, queremos aproveitar este momento para agradecer. A empolgação e a paixão da comunidade tornaram este um momento verdadeiramente especial para todos nós. O lançamento de GTAVI marca um momento extraordinário para os jogos e o entretenimento, tornando-se o maior lançamento de um jogo na história de PlayStation, ao longo de três décadas e cinco gerações de consoles. Mais de 39 milhões de jogadores únicos vivenciaram a história de Jason e Lucia em Grand Theft Auto VI para PlayStation 5. A comunidade PlayStation se uniu de forma expressiva para vivenciar Grand Theft Auto VI durante seu lançamento e fim de semana de estreia. Confira alguns destaques do período de lançamento, encerrado em 22 de novembro de 2026*: Estas são apenas algumas das maneiras pelas quais vimos nossa comunidade PlayStation se unir em torno deste momento incrível no mundo dos jogos, e estamos empolgados para ver como vocês continuarão criando e compartilhando novas memórias e experiências nos próximos meses. Por fim, gostaríamos de parabenizar nossos parceiros da Rockstar Games por trazerem este jogo extraordinário a jogadores de todo o mundo e por darem continuidade a uma parceria com a PlayStation que vem desde o Grand Theft Auto III, para PlayStation 2. Com GTAVI, trabalhamos para oferecer a melhor experiência no console PS5 e proporcionamos aos jogadores uma forma memorável de celebrar o título, por meio de dois controles sem fio DualSense de edição limitada, inspirados em Vice City. Também celebramos o lançamento com eventos ao vivo, incluindo o “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival”, realizado em Miami no último fim de semana. E à nossa comunidade PlayStation, obrigado pela paixão e pelo apoio contínuos, e por escolherem vivenciar GTAVI no console PS5 . É o entusiasmo de vocês que torna momentos como este tão significativos para todos nós. Mal podemos esperar para ver aonde suas aventuras em Leonida levarão vocês! *Todos os números baseiam-se em dados internos da SIE coletados de 19 de novembro de 2026 a 22 de novembro de 2026.

sources.title: Grand Theft Auto VI for PS5 tops 39 million players
sources.text: More than 39 million unique users have played Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 as of November 22, making it the biggest launch in PlayStation history across three decades and five console generations, Sony Interactive Entertainment announced . The sequel set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles. Across PlayStation 5, players cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay in Grand Theft Auto VI , and have spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the game’s world during its opening days. Grand Theft Auto VI ‘s launch also marked the largest number of newly connected PlayStation 5 consoles on a single day since the console’s launch, outside of end-of-year holidays. Since launch, it was the first played game on 70 percent of new PlayStation 5 consoles. “We want to congratulate our partners at Rockstar Games for bringing this extraordinary game to players around the world and continuing a partnership with PlayStation that stretches back to Grand Theft Auto III on PlayStation 2 ,” Sony Interactive Entertainment content communications manager Tim Turi said. “With [ Grand Theft Auto VI ], we worked to bring the best experience on [PlayStation 5] and gave players a memorable way to commemorate the game with two special limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City. We also celebrated the launch with live events including Grand Theft Auto VI : The Festival in Miami this past weekend.” Grand Theft Auto VI launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series on November 19. On November 20, Rockstar Games announced that the game achieved $3.79 billion in day one retail sales following 32.5 million pre-sales. Although Rockstar Games did not share exact unit numbers, the revenue total suggests roughly 37.9 million to 47.3 million copies sold, based solely on pricing across its $79.99 and $99.99 editions.

sources.title: Nioh 3 Is Coming to XBOX in 2027
sources.text: 2025 marked the “Year of the Ninja” when the legendary Team NINJA development team released both Ninja Gaiden 2 Black and Ninja Gaiden 4 . Well, 2027 is poised to be the “Return of the Ninja” as for the first time ever, the Nioh series is making its debut on XBOX with Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: Complete Edition coming to XBOX Series X|S . The Complete Edition includes the full game and the two DLC expansions, which brings new story content, new bosses, new weapons, new abilities, endgame content, and more. For XBOX players, this is the perfect entry point into the series as it features the pinnacle of combat refinement you’ve come to know and expect from Team NINJA, as well as an open-field format that lets you explore and take on challenges at your own pace. No prior series knowledge is needed to understand the epic story that takes place across multiple eras of feudal Japan! If you aren’t familiar with Nioh 3 , it’s Team NINJA’s take on the Age of the Samurai in Japan, as an open-field Dark Samurai Action RPG where you’re caught in a nefarious coup started right before you are appointed Shogun – the ruler of Japan. You play the role of Tokugawa Takechiyo, and just before taking the throne, your younger brother succumbs to his hatred and jealousy, and leads an army of Yokai (demonic spirits) to overthrow the natural order and take over Japan. Takechiyo survives thanks to the intervention of the Guardian Spirit Kusanagi, who lets you travel through time and experience battlefields across different eras and key locations. In order to deal with the hordes of demonic Yokai, human rebels, and giant, grotesque bosses standing in your way of getting revenge on your younger brother and becoming the true Shogun of Japan, Takechiyo has some excellent tutelage in both Samurai and Ninja combat. In a series-first, you can switch seamlessly between the Samurai combat style and the new Ninja combat style: Samurai combat relies on specific weapon stances, which holds the keys to unlocking devastating combos, whereas Ninja combat relies on faster, fluid movements, aerial attacks, and elusiveness to chain together relentless attacks. Takechiyo, as one would expect of a Shogun-to-be, can wield a series-high amount of weapons – from a variety of swords, bows, gunpowder weapons, axes, spears, fist weapons, and more. Weapons and armor provide increases for a wide variety of combat stats – with plenty of drops to sort through, finding the right weapon with the perfect stats to complement your play style is a key element of the Nioh series. Players also have access to Transformed Arts, Ninjutsu, Onmyo Magic and creatures summoned through Summoning Seals for you to perfect the ultimate combat style. Team NINJA is in peak form with the combat of Nioh 3 , and XBOX players getting to experience it for the first time is a key reason why 2027 marks the Return of the Ninja. After years of the development team experimenting and tweaking the series formula for Nioh 3, and following the incredible Xbox fan reactions to Ninja Gaiden 4 on XBOX, the team felt it was the perfect moment to release the series on XBOX – just in time for the series’ 10 th anniversary. The Nioh 3: Complete Edition gives XBOX players access to the base game, but also the two DLC expansions, Hell Rising and Bloody Insurrection . Both DLC expansions add to the game’s story with new Eras and locations to explore, adding new equipment, combat abilities, skills, and much more. The DLC also adds several end-game level modes, such as the Battlefield of Carnage, which challenges you to take on 100 floors of battlefields overrun with enemies and bosses. Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: Complete Edition will launch for the first time on XBOX Series X|S beginning January 28, 2027 – don’t miss out on the epic battle!

sources.text: 2025 foi o “Ano do Ninja”: a lendária equipe de desenvolvimento Team NINJA lançou Ninja Gaiden 2 Black e Ninja Gaiden 4 . Já 2027 promete ser o ano do “Retorno do Ninja”: pela primeira vez, a série Nioh chega ao XBOX, com Nioh 3 e Nioh 3: Complete Edition no XBOX Series X|S. A edição completa inclui o jogo base e as duas expansões (DLCs), que trazem novos capítulos da história, novos chefes, armas e habilidades inéditas, conteúdo para depois da campanha e muito mais. Para quem joga no XBOX, essa é a oportunidade ideal para conhecer a série: o jogo leva o refinamento do combate do Team NINJA a um novo patamar e oferece áreas abertas para explorar e encarar desafios no seu ritmo. E você não precisa ter jogado os títulos anteriores para acompanhar essa história épica, que atravessa várias eras do Japão feudal! Se você ainda não conhece Nioh 3 , o jogo é a versão do Team NINJA para a era dos samurais no Japão. Nesse RPG de ação samurai com atmosfera sombria e áreas abertas para explorar, você assume o papel de Tokugawa Takechiyo e se vê no meio de um golpe às vésperas de assumir o posto de xogum, governante do Japão. Movido pelo ódio e pela inveja, seu irmão mais novo lidera um exército de yokai (espíritos demoníacos) para subverter a ordem natural e tomar o controle do país. Takechiyo sobrevive graças à intervenção do Espírito Guardião Kusanagi, que permite a você viajar no tempo e conhecer campos de batalha em diferentes épocas e locais importantes. Para se vingar do irmão mais novo e se tornar o verdadeiro xogum do Japão, Takechiyo precisa enfrentar hordas de yokai demoníacos, rebeldes humanos e chefes gigantescos e grotescos. Para isso, ele conta com um treinamento completo nos estilos de combate Samurai e Ninja. Pela primeira vez na série, você pode alternar com fluidez entre o estilo Samurai e o novo estilo Ninja. No estilo Samurai, cada arma tem posturas específicas que permitem executar combos devastadores. Já no estilo Ninja, movimentos mais rápidos e fluidos, ataques aéreos e esquivas permitem encadear golpes sem dar trégua aos inimigos. Como se espera de um futuro xogum, Takechiyo pode empunhar o maior arsenal da série, que inclui diversos tipos de espadas, arcos, armas de pólvora, machados, lanças, armas de punho e muito mais. Armas e armaduras melhoram diversos atributos de combate. Com tantos equipamentos para coletar, encontrar a arma certa, com os atributos ideais para o seu jeito de jogar, é um dos elementos centrais da série Nioh. Para aperfeiçoar seu estilo de combate, você também pode recorrer às Artes Transformadas, ao Ninjutsu, à Magia Onmyo e a criaturas invocadas por meio de Selos de Invocação. O combate de Nioh 3 mostra o Team NINJA no auge. E o fato de quem joga no XBOX poder experimentá-lo pela primeira vez é um dos principais motivos pelos quais 2027 marca o “Retorno do Ninja”. Depois de anos testando e ajustando a fórmula da série para Nioh 3 , e diante da excelente recepção de Ninja Gaiden 4 entre os fãs de XBOX, a equipe achou que era o momento ideal para levar Nioh à plataforma, bem a tempo de comemorar os dez anos da série. Nioh 3: Complete Edition dá a quem joga no XBOX acesso ao jogo base e às duas expansões: Hell Rising e Bloody Insurrection . As duas ampliam a história do jogo com novas eras e locais para explorar, além de novos equipamentos, habilidades de combate, técnicas e muito mais. As expansões também trazem vários modos para depois da campanha, como o Battlefield of Carnage , que desafia você a percorrer 100 andares de campos de batalha tomados por inimigos e chefes. Nioh 3 e Nioh 3: Complete Edition serão lançados pela primeira vez ao XBOX Series X|S em 28 de janeiro de 2027. Não perca essa batalha épica!

sources.text: Koei Tecmo has announced the second and final DLC for Nioh 3 will be released next month, with an Xbox version of the game to follow in 2027. Koei Tecmo and Team Ninja are a pretty busy bunch. Nioh 3 released earlier this year and has remained one of the best action games of 2026, which was only around four months after Ninja Gaiden 4 was released. On top of that, Fatal Frame 2: Crimson Butterfly Remake released a month after Nioh, and Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember is set to release next March – and that's not even mentioning the new Dead or Alive game that's on the way. And yet, somehow, the developer is still able to get the DLC for Nioh 3 out months ahead of schedule. Nioh 3's first DLC pack, Hell Rising, arrived in August ahead of its October release date, and now Koei Tecmo has confirmed that Nioh 3's second DLC, Bloody Insurrection, is releasing on December 17, 2026, which is a little bit ahead of its previously stated February release date. The DLC is set to have a new stage – Shimbara in 1638 – and The Battlefield of Carnage which seems to be the game's equivalent of something like Devil May Cry's Bloody Palace. On top of all of that, the developer has announced that Nioh 3 will be the first game to release on Xbox consoles after a disclaimer teased this back in February . The Nioh 3 Complete Edition, which naturally includes the game and its DLC, will be released on January 28, 2027 for PS5, PC, and Xbox Series X|S. sources.text: The industry is finding new milestones to measure GTA 6's success. GTA 6 has been shattering records since before it came out, becoming the top-rated game in the history of Metacritic before it had the biggest entertainment launch (by dollars) in history. Sony is now joining in that victory lap by sharing GTA 6 milestones as they pertain to PlayStation. "More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia's story in Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5," Sony content communications manager Tim Turi wrote in a blog post today. That is a staggering number, especially considering GTA 6 also launched on Xbox and will (eventually) hit PC . But that's not a sales record—Rockstar still has a ways to go to surpass GTA 5's 230 million lifetime sales . What is unprecedented, at least for PlayStation, is GTA 6's concurrents over launch weekend. "GTA 6 set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles," Turi said. That's the wild one to me, because that means more people were playing GTA 6 at the same time on the largest console platform than Call of Duty, GTA 5 , or even Fortnite has ever achieved. Turi didn't share the concurrent figure itself, which is too bad—Steam remains the only platform that hands out exact player data. If the figure is theoretically higher than some of the biggest concurrent peaks we know about on Steam, then it could've been as high as 3-4 million players. On average, those 39 million PS5 players logged 17.4 hours over four days. sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is the "first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles" GTA 6 isn't just smashing records as the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic – it's also apparently surpassing massive milestones on consoles like the PlayStation 5. The company reveals as much in a new blog post , writing, "The launch of GTA 6 marks an extraordinary moment for gaming and entertainment, becoming the biggest game launch in PlayStation history, across three decades and five console generations." Sony goes on to specify just how many players constitute "the biggest" release: "More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia's story in Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5." Nearly 40 million. "GTA 6 set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles." That's no small feat, considering this includes… well, everything. From online games like Fortnite to more recent single-player launches like Ghost of Tsushima sequel Ghost of Yotei – and everything before them on every single PlayStation system to date. And, it appears folks helping set this record on PS5 are actually spending quite a bit of time in Grand Theft Auto 6 as well… not just purchasing it. "Across PS5, players cumulatively logged an incredible 683 million hours of gameplay in GTA 6," as Sony writes," reflecting the enthusiasm of the PlayStation community. Each player has spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the state of Leonida during the game's opening days." That's not bad, considering just how behemoth-like Rockstar seems. It's only been a few days, and the community is clearly engaging with it. GTA 6 is boosting console sales, too. Sony apparently "saw the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the console's launch, outside of end-of-year holidays." And, "since its launch, GTA 6 was the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles." This all checks out – heck, following the GTA 6 extended look on Netflix in August, we saw a surge in both PS5 and Xbox Series X sales . When it comes to the new Grand Theft Auto, we're talking about a mind-boggling $3.79 billion launch across platforms – and it's not even out on PC yet. sources.text: The companies are old friends in the industry Remakes of the first two Max Payne games are on the way, and Rockstar 's been helping Remedy get the releases in order. According to the Control and Alan Wake studio, collaborating with the purveyor of GTA 6 has been absolutely grand so far. Jean-Charles Gaudechon, the CEO of Remedy, described the working relationship between the two outfits in glowing terms for Game File . "Honestly, it's been great," he says. "You know why? Because I think they're super respectful of Remedy." Respect is a good start to any collaboration. Gaudechon then doubles down, just to make it clear everything's positive right now. "I'll say it out loud: They've honestly been an awesome partner," he adds. "And it's no bullshit." Well, it seems he doesn't have any complaints, anyway. Remedy and Rockstar actually have quite a bit of history, since the studio that gave us GTA actually worked on ports of the first Max Payne, then published the second outright. It only makes sense, then, that they'd team back up to give both games a lick of paint and update them for modern hardware. As you may well be aware, it's been a while since Rockstar's done anything outside of the Grand Theft Auto or Red Dead Redemption mines. Time was the developer and publisher would be involved in all sorts of projects, but nowadays the focus tends to be a little more streamlined. I guess that's what happens when you make the biggest games in the industry. The two have been working on these do-overs since around 2022, and we don't have a release window yet. Perhaps now that Alan Wake 2 and Control: Resonant are out of the way, Remedy can put in more resource, while Rockstar can finally do something that isn't GTA 6. I mean, how much is there to do post-launch for such a game? Our boy Max is waiting, people – come on. sources.text: "I'll say it out loud: They've honestly been an awesome partner." Alan Wake and Control studio Remedy Entertainment is currently developing a highly-anticipated Max Payne 1 & 2 remake. The Finnish studio is doing so in partnership with Grand Theft Auto 6 studio Rockstar, which owns the IP and is funding the remake's development. So how has that relationship been? According to Remedy CEO Jean-Charles Gaudechon, working with Rockstar has been "amazing". "Honestly, it's been great," Gaudechon told Game File . "You know why? Because I think they're super respectful of Remedy." Gaudechon is so positive on Remedy's working relationship with Rockstar that he emphasised his praise for Rockstar further. "I'll say it out loud: They've honestly been an awesome partner. And it's no bullshit," he added. The original Max Payne was released in 2001, and its sequel in 2003 - both developed by Remedy. Rockstar published the second game and worked on the original's console ports. Rockstar developed a third entry in the series, Max Payne 3 , which Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser recently called something of a failure . "Some people liked it; lots didn't. So we got it wrong, or I got it wrong. I failed. My bit was not a success," said Houser. The Max Payne 1 & 2 remake has been in the works since 2022 , but only entered full production in 2024 . The game is understood to be Remedy's current project, though the studio also has another unannounced project in the works. In other Remedy news, the studio recently posted one of its best financial quarters , off the back of the release of Control Resonant, the studio's fastest-selling game ever .

sources.title: GTA 6 just got a patch that fixed a progression bug on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S
sources.text: Rockstar just issued a new patch for GTA 6 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, targeting a few issues players have been reporting since the game launched last Thursday (19th November). The 23rd November patch for the game deploys seven major fixes for the game, including a pretty significant bug that prevented phone calls not triggering at certain points, resulting in a scenario where you could be locked out of progressing the game. The official update is titled 'version 01.002.002', and its weighs in at different sizes on different consoles: it's 603.8 MB on PS5, and 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X/S. Thanks to an update on the Rockstar website , you can read all of the updates that arrive with the latest pathc below. There have been a few fairly high-profile cases of the autosave not working as the developer intended, leading to a few cases of streamers losing plenty of real-world time thanks to unpredictable auto-save behaviour. JasonTheWeen lost 12 hours of progress on the PS5 , for example. But there's one issue here the developer hasn't addressed: vignetting. Plenty of players have taken to online communities to complain about the vignette effect that pops into the game - theoretically to help with motion smoothing and various grapihcal elements as the game runs in 30FPS. THe effect is worsened when you're fatigued, hungry, or have some other status effect, but it is present quite a lot of the time, too. Most of the responses to a tweet about the patch posted by the Rockstar Support account reference the vignetting in GTA 6, and the developer has issued no response at the time of writing.

sources.title: Bug de GTA 6 destrava fps no Xbox Series X|S e revela limites de desempenho
sources.text: Dica para deixar GTA 6 no padrão brasileiro: veja como mudar unidades de medida Um bug relacionado ao Quick Resume do Xbox Series X|S destrava a taxa de quadros por segundo de GTA 6 . A falha permitiu testar os limites dos consoles da Microsoft e reforça que, embora exista uma margem de desempenho considerável, a trava de 30 fps é interessante para manter uma experiência consistente, concluiu o Digital Foundry . Um relato sobre o bug foi publicado pelo u/Meowwie64 no subreddit r/gtaglitches. No texto, ele descreve como reproduzir a falha nos consoles Xbox Series X|S. A Rockstar lançou Grand Theft Auto 6 com desempenho travado em 30 quadros por segundo em todos os consoles — Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 e PlayStation 5 Pro. O jogo foi desenvolvido pensando em alcançar essa taxa de quadros . Sem a trava de 30 fps, o console pode renderizar quantos quadros por segundo seu hardware permitir . Isso é basicamente o que acontece nos computadores em muitos jogos, exceto naqueles que limitam a taxa de quadros a um valor específico por razões técnicas. Para reproduzir o glitch , é necessário ter um Xbox Series X|S, um display com suporte à taxa de atualização de 120 Hz e GTA 6 na versão 01.002.001 . O autor da publicação não menciona a versão específica do firmware do console, porém, considerando o comportamento da falha, esse também pode ser um fator relevante para o procedimento. O processo para reproduzir o glitch é relativamente simples: Se tudo foi feito no momento certo, GTA 6 provavelmente estará com a taxa de quadros destravada . Isso permite que o console renderize imagens acima do limite de 30 fps definido pela Rockstar. A reprodução acima de 30 fps é resultado de um bug cuja causa ainda não foi identificada, mas que provavelmente será resolvido por um patch de correção . Além disso, apesar de o Xbox Series S também permitir reproduzir a falha, o hardware mais limitado do console não consegue renderizar muitos quadros além do limite original. O site e canal do YouTube Digital Foundry testou o glitch e avaliou como o Xbox Series X reproduz GTA 6 sem o limite na taxa de quadros. Em boa parte da jogabilidade, o console da Microsoft consegue entregar mais de 30 fps, mas o desempenho está longe de ser estável . Segundo o veículo, trechos muito movimentados (tiroteios, explosões e perseguições) fazem o desempenho cair abaixo dos 30 fps , assim como acontece na jogabilidade sem o glitch . Dirigir em alta velocidade por rodovias urbanas também faz a taxa de quadros se aproximar do limite original. Porém, em trechos mais tranquilos ou ao dirigir em alta velocidade por rodovias menos movimentadas, o console consegue alcançar 40 fps ou mais. Nos testes do Digital Foundry , o Xbox Series X chegou a 60 fps ao pilotar um avião e olhar diretamente para o céu — uma situação pouco frequente durante a jogatina convencional. Contudo, a taxa de quadros adicional vem com efeitos colaterais: por algum motivo, o jogo parece rodar de forma acelerada quando alcança taxas mais elevadas . O game ainda é jogável, mas o comportamento reforça que a reprodução acima de 30 fps não estava prevista e pode comprometer algumas animações. No Xbox Series S, destravar a taxa de quadros não traz muitos benefícios . O console consegue reproduzir o game com mais de 30 quadros por segundo em determinados cenários, como cutscenes ou ao olhar diretamente para o céu em áreas abertas, mas os ganhos são limitados. Isso acontece porque destravar a taxa de quadros não garante mais desempenho magicamente . Sem o bloqueio original, o console fica limitado ao potencial do próprio hardware, e os testes já mostraram que GTA 6 é um título bastante pesado até para os videogames da atual geração. Quer ficar por dentro das novidades do mundo dos games? Acesse o VOXL e acompanhe as últimas notícias sobre GTA 6 , Xbox e desempenho nos consoles. /Com informações de Digital Foundry .
